detail.command:
set -e
printf '%s\n' '--- IDENTITIES ---'
security find-identity -v -p codesigning || true
printf '%s\n' '--- PROVISIONING TEAMS ---'
find ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 | while read f; do security cms -D -i "$f" 2>/dev/null | plutil -extract TeamIdentifier.0 raw -o - - 2>/dev/null || true; done | sort -u
printf '%s\n' '--- XCODE ACCOUNTS ---'
defaults read com.apple.dt.Xcode IDEProvisioningTeamByIdentifier 2>/dev/null || true
